dependency_boundary_policy: Audit actual source, build/link rules and staged library symbols/NEEDED edges. Exclude a supporting dependency from OpenSSL migration only with evidence that it has no reachable OpenSSL API use and no libssl/libcrypto linkage. If positive or unknown, extend the audited dependency closure; do not edit unrelated components.

global_baseline.description: Retain all 68 original API candidates for traceability. Only target-preprocessed ACTIVE EasyMesh call sites require migration review; EXCLUDED_WITH_EVIDENCE items remain as evidence and do not trigger source changes.
